segments.comment: A Priest drops a wished jackal corpse named Rex and zaps a wand of undead turning down at it. zap.c bhito() announces the revived monster with noname_monnam(mtmp, ARTICLE_THE), so C prints "The jackal is resurrected!" without the name revive() copied from the corpse. Seed, date, character, species and name chosen independently of the batch 14 pilot.
